state.completed_batches_meaning: local_batch_read_and_filtered_only; not all items externally searched

state.extra_selection_rule: Per batch, added exact consumables/storage/PC peripherals categories C>=3m; all other first-pass category selection retained
state.actual_search_count_meaning: unique item IDs with saved Parallel searches or explicit web-search provenance list; local-only selections excluded
state.delivery_count_meaning: local_delivery_count is sum of deduplicated max(dlv_lines), not unique request_no count; request_no counts must come from official item facts
